player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Muena manaya eu uvua musue kuitaba bua kumuanyangana nende kayi ne bintu bivua bikengela.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Mwana {player_id}, Nketo te. Lumbu {col} i zingila kuna.
invalid_move.already_full: Mwana {player_id}, Nketo te. Lumbu {col} i zeanza.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Muena manaya {player_id} uvua ukeba bua kupingaja makuta kayi ne bintu bivua bikengela.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Muena manaya {player_id} uvua mufile dilomba dia kusumba bintu ne mushindu mubi.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Muena manaya {player_id} kavua mufile dilomba dikuabu dia kusumba to.

offers.reject: Muena manaya {player_id} wakabenga dilomba dia kusumba.
offers.accept: Muena manaya {acceptor_id} wakitaba dilomba dia kunshintulula kudi muena manayi {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Mwana {player_id} akelaki nketo kwa Mwana {opponent_id}: Bizali bimponenekela: {offered} -> Bizali bimponenaki: {requested}

outcome.win: Muena manaya {winner_id} uvua mupete difutu dia bungi bualu bavua bapatule bintu bia mushinga mukole.
outcome.draw: Badi bashintuluka mushindu umue mu mushinga wa bintu bia banayi bonso.
